claim: A relator score computed from the trained operators alone (before any test) separates successful from failed S5 training runs: on 40 fresh seeds, all 17 runs scoring >= 5 succeeded at L=160 and all 17 scoring <= 3 failed; accepting the first run scoring >= 5 in each group of 4 delivered a working model in 9 of 10 groups (blind choice: 2 of 10).
limits: The score uses S5's known relations (a mechanistic diagnostic, not self-assessment); score 4 is ambiguous (4 of 6 succeeded); one group and width; x86_64 only; D1, D2 and D4 are not independent.
